mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucose from portal blood through glycogen storage, release and transport was worthwhile: the sequence connects a familiar molecule to the liver's role between meals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the portal vessel was clear but mechanically straightforward; the result did not add much explanation beyond the named slot.

surprise.text: The sequence clarified that liver cells can store glucose as branching glycogen and later release glucose into blood for other tissues.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the final integration leaves the specific nerve and lymph connections unexplained in its brief description.

continue.text: I would be interested in continuing if another chapter developed these system connections in comparable detail; the glucose sequence was clear, though the combinations themselves were fairly predictable.
